moderation.title: Advanced Moderation & AutoMod
moderation.description: Keep your community safe with lightning-fast automated moderation, advanced word filtering, and a comprehensive audit log.

automod.title: AutoMod V2
automod.desc: Regex, mention-spam, and attachment-spam triggers instantly quarantine suspicious accounts.

warning.title: Warning Escalation
warning.desc: Automatically kick, mute, or ban users who accrue too many warnings.

auditing.title: Detailed Auditing
auditing.desc: Every action is logged in detailed, easy-to-read Discord embeds.

economy.title: Economy, XP & Leveling
economy.description: Transform your server into an engaging RPG. Reward activity with currency, levels, and custom rank cards.

rankCards.title: Dynamic Rank Cards
rankCards.desc: Beautiful generated images showcasing user level, rank, and progress.

globalEconomy.title: Global & Local Economy
globalEconomy.desc: Work, rob, gamble, and claim daily rewards to climb the leaderboards.

roleRewards.title: Role Rewards
roleRewards.desc: Automatically assign Discord roles when users reach specific levels.

tickets.title: Professional Support Tickets
tickets.description: Streamline community support with multi-department ticket panels, claims, and full transcripts.

multiDepartment.title: Multi-Department Panels
multiDepartment.desc: Let users choose what they need help with (e.g. Support, Billing, Applications).

staffTooling.title: Staff Tooling
staffTooling.desc: Claim, freeze, lock, and close operations for your moderation team.

webTranscripts.title: Web Transcripts
webTranscripts.desc: Automatically generate and save HTML transcripts when a ticket closes.

tickets.supportCenterDesc: Need help? Click the button below that matches your inquiry to open a private thread with our staff team.

giveaways.title: Giveaways & Events
giveaways.description: Host highly configurable giveaways to boost engagement and reward your most active community members.

multiWinner.title: Multi-Winner Support
multiWinner.desc: Select multiple winners automatically when the timer ends.

entryReqs.title: Entry Requirements
entryReqs.desc: Require users to have a specific role or minimum level to enter.

bonusEntries.title: Bonus Entries
bonusEntries.desc: Give server boosters or VIP members a higher chance to win.

fun.title: Fun & Minigames
fun.description: Keep your chat active even when there's nothing to talk about. Built-in minigames that hook right into the economy.

interactiveGames.title: Interactive Games
interactiveGames.desc: Play Tic-Tac-Toe, Trivia, or Russian Roulette directly in Discord channels.

bettingWagers.title: Betting & Wagers
bettingWagers.desc: Let users wager their economy coins in games against the bot or each other.

socialCommands.title: Social Commands
socialCommands.desc: Hug, slap, kiss, or pat other users with generated anime GIFs.

fun.triviaQuestion: What year was Discord officially released to the public?

infrastructure.title: Server Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Automate your server's voice channels. Join-to-Create ensures you never have a cluttered, empty voice channel list again.

dynamicVoice.title: Dynamic Voice Channels
dynamicVoice.desc: A new channel is created instantly when a user joins the master hub.

autoCleanup.title: Auto-Cleanup
autoCleanup.desc: The channel deletes itself the second the last person leaves.

ownerControls.title: Owner Controls
ownerControls.desc: Channel creators get access to a panel to lock, limit, or rename their temporary channel.

engagement.title: Engagement & Statistics
engagement.description: Track user activity across your server and reward your most active members.

voiceTracking.title: Voice Tracking
voiceTracking.desc: Monitor how much time users spend in voice channels.

messageTracking.title: Message Tracking
messageTracking.desc: Count messages sent to find your most active chatters.

rewards.title: Activity Rewards
rewards.desc: Automatically grant currency based on activity.

customCommands.title: Custom Commands
customCommands.description: Create your own commands and auto-responses tailored to your server's unique needs.

autoResponders.title: Auto-Responders
autoResponders.desc: The bot automatically replies to specific keywords.

variables.title: Dynamic Variables
variables.desc: Use variables like {user} and {server} in your responses.

embeds.title: Rich Embeds
embeds.desc: Format your custom responses using beautiful Discord embeds.

dashboard.title: Web Dashboard & Analytics
dashboard.description: Control every aspect of your bot from a state-of-the-art web interface with real-time syncing.

realtime.title: Real-Time Sync
realtime.desc: Settings update instantly in your server without needing to restart the bot.

analytics.title: Server Analytics
analytics.desc: View deep insights into your server's growth and economy circulation.

mobileReady.title: Mobile Ready
mobileReady.desc: Manage your server on the go with our fully responsive dashboard.

roles.title: Advanced Role Management
roles.description: Give your community the power to express themselves with reaction roles and automated assigning.

reactionRoles.title: Reaction Roles
reactionRoles.desc: Allow users to self-assign roles by reacting to messages.

stickyRoles.title: Sticky Roles
stickyRoles.desc: Restore a user's roles automatically if they leave and rejoin.

temporaryRoles.title: Temporary Roles
temporaryRoles.desc: Grant VIP or special roles that automatically expire after a set time.
